description: This file defines a class TasksSwipeToDeleteCallback that extends ItemTouchHelper.SimpleCallback to facilitate swipe-to-delete functionality in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: TasksSwipeToDeleteCallback
classes.description: A callback class for handling swipe gestures on RecyclerView items to enable delete actions.

methods.name: onMove
methods.description: Disabled movement; returns false indicating items cannot be moved via this callback.

methods.name: onSwiped
methods.description: Invokes the provided callback with the position of the swiped item.
